reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text:
My experience with Fanatics has been absolutely frustrating. I was simply trying to withdraw my cash, only to be told that it had expired. When I questioned how their expiration policy and limits were somehow my responsibility as a customer, instead of providing an explanation or attempting to resolve the issue, they suspended my account.

It is unacceptable to treat customers this way, especially when they are simply asking legitimate questions about their own money. Rather than offering transparency, accountability, or assistance, Fanatics chose to shut down the conversation by suspending my account.

I would strongly caution anyone considering using Fanatics. If you run into an issue trying to access your money, don’t expect to be treated fairly or receive helpful customer support. Extremely disappointed with this company.

reviews.title: Something Is Seriously Off With Customer Support
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Fanatics Sportsbook for a while and something has changed for the worse. The first level of customer service reps are incredibly short, dismissive, and honestly come off rude and standoffish. It feels like they skim the messages, don’t read what you actually wrote, and then respond with copy-and-paste AI scripts that have nothing to do with your issue. It’s sad, especially for an app that’s supposed to be competitive in the market.

I’ve wagered more than ever in the last few months, yet my rewards suddenly dropped to zero. Every time I try to get a real explanation, I’m met with contradictions and the same canned answers on repeat. No one seems willing to look at the actual account history or give a straight answer.

If Fanatics wants to keep players, the player support experience needs a complete overhaul. Right now, it feels like you’re talking to a bot that’s trained to say “nothing changed” even when everything clearly did.
